title: Flying_8lack's random mod
description: A non-vanilla+ mod that add various useful utilities and funny features with no specific theme.
body:
A non-vanilia+ mod that do not follow a specific theme. this mod contains some useful utilites and other random features that author find either useful or fun. 


### Noteable features:
- Horizontal Elevators
- Silly mining machine
- Fig ecosystem (entities, food, status effect)


### What is inside the mod?

Fig is a key to many things in this mod. Fig itself is a food that provide health boost for a limited time. it is required item in most crafting recipes. Figs can not be planted. instead, fig can be looted from the fig entities. 

fig entities are passive mobs that drops fig. fig entitiy has two special attacks: charged jump and fig projectile. The Fig is a slow entity, so a jump mechanic allow it to close the distance. the fig projectile is an avoidable homing fig that on impact gives the slowness effect for a few seconds. the fig projectile is only used when the target is far away. they can be found in any plains biome.

![A fig in the field](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01ce8cb06b7bc5a0a18687ee7fc1b3f772e5f5fb.png)

Silly miner block: It is a machine that mines an 9x9 hole into the ground below. Unlike other technology mods, this do not use any form of energy. As long as there is a pickaxe inside it, it will continue to mine blocks. A chest or any other storage blocks should be placed on top of the silly miner to store the resources, otherwise, it will drop the mined resources on top of it. 

figification status effect: overtime it has a chance to randomly spawn fig entities that will attack you. the lower the health, the less likely to spawn a fig.

Horizontal Elevators allows teleportation acorss blocks and rooms. these make it suitable to allow access in disjoint rooms.
